definitions.gloss: emergence; eclosion; hatching into adult form
definitions.explanation: The final stage of insect metamorphosis when the adult insect emerges from its pupa or nymph stage and develops wings. A biology term also used figuratively.

examples.english: The cicada emerged from its shell.

examples.japanese: {蝶|ちょう}の{羽化|うか}を{観察|かんさつ}した。
{子供|こども}たちはカブトムシが{羽化|うか}する{瞬間|しゅんかん}を{見|み}て{大喜|おおよろこ}びした。
examples.english: The children were thrilled to see the moment the beetle emerged as an adult.

notes: Composed of {羽|う} (wing, feather) + {化|か} (transformation). Literally 'becoming winged.' Used primarily in biology and nature observation contexts. A popular subject in Japanese elementary school science classes, where children often raise insects and observe their {羽化|うか}. Also appears in the Daoist expression {羽化|うか}{登仙|とうせん} (ascending to heaven as an immortal), which uses the same characters metaphorically.
